ai.analysis: Gold is flat on the day near 4,028 after a brutal Thursday that took it down 2.8%, and an Asian session that printed 3,987 — the first trade under $4,000 since July. The driver is the Fed: Brent at $113-114 on the Strait of Hormuz crisis has revived inflation fear, and FedWatch now prices a 75.2% chance of a 25bp hike on December 9 plus 15.2% on 50bp, with only 9.6% on a hold, so the policy backdrop is hawkish, not dovish. What makes today awkward is that almost everything that normally lifts gold is lifting — the 10Y real yield fell 14bp in five sessions to 2.64%, the 2Y dropped 12bp to 4.65%, the VIX jumped 14.1% in an AI-led equity rout, and specs are not crowded at 107k managed-money net long — and gold was sold anyway, which looks like forced liquidation to cover equity losses rather than a macro verdict. That correlation break is now six sessions old, and it is why this is a neutral call and not a buy. Reclaiming 4,065-4,070 and holding would say the liquidation is done and the real-yield signal is back in charge; acceptance below 3,987 confirms the hawkish read and opens 3,950, and the FOMC on Oct 27-28 and PCE on Oct 29 are what actually settle it.

dayType.reason: London poked below yesterday's 4,027 low to 4,019 but has already reclaimed it and is back at 4,039, so nothing is holding beyond the level. London's 205 pips is under the 220 range threshold and well under the 265 needed for trend — but the whole day is already 398 pips, close to a median 441, so the move happened overnight in Asia rather than in London.

flags: Correlation break, day six: gold -2.8% Thursday and through $4,000 overnight while the 10Y real yield fell 14bp to 2.64%, the 2Y fell 12bp to 4.65% and the VIX rose 14.1% — all three normally gold-positive. Gold is trading the oil-inflation / December-hike story, not its master driver. Note the oil layer scores +1 by the rule (crude bid) while its live transmission into gold today is bearish, via hike bets. Session splits today come from Kraken PAXG/USD hourly, a gold-backed proxy running roughly $10-12 above spot with slightly tighter extremes, so priorRange 668 may understate the true NY range — spot's own Oct 22 low was 4,020.90 against the proxy's 4,027.17. This is still a real session split, where the last two runs had none. Myfxbook returned figures identical to yesterday's run to two decimals, so that page may be cached. COT is the Oct 13 report, 10 days old, next print 15:30 ET today. No clean 5-sessions-ago DXY level was sourced. Real yields and the 2Y are Treasury par-curve Oct 22 closes, a day stale by design.
headline: NEUTRAL — the stack is BUY-SIDE (+3: real yields -14bp, 2Y -12bp, Brent $113, VIX +14%) but gold broke a three-month low under $4,000 on 90% December hike odds, so price has the floor until it reclaims 4,065-4,070.

mind.line: Rates, oil and risk-off say buy; the dollar and the tape say sell, and the tape has been right for six sessions — that is no edge, not a fade. It becomes a buy only on a reclaim of 4,065-4,070 that holds while real yields stay down; it becomes a sell on acceptance back under 3,987. A hot PCE next Thursday, or December hike odds pushing past 95%, kills the bullish case outright.
